rule: An external item matches an Atlas problem when the NFKD-folded, lower-cased, punctuation-free item base title (text before ' — ') equals the Atlas title, optionally after stripping trailing generic words (conjecture/problem/hypothesis/theorem/question); data/external/crosswalk-overrides.yaml adds reviewed ids (optionally fixing their relation) or removes false positives. Default relation=primary iff the id has no '.variants.' segment and the title has no ' — ' suffix; 'related' links never raise status signals.
